title: Sarbacher known to Australian nuclear engineers; Woomera

tellings.quote: Ross Coloulthart has some interesting data points around some of the nuclear engineers,

plain: In the 1950s, it is said, nuclear engineers in Australia knew of the American scientist Robert Sarbacher, with a link to Woomera, a weapons test site in the Australian outback. Michels mentions it only in passing, on a 2025 episode with the writer Whitley Strieber. He says the Australian journalist Ross Coulthart has "interesting data points" about these engineers, and he raises it as backing for Sarbacher's place in the UFO story, without giving the details.
